faqs.question: Does it work without IELTS or final grades?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tell it what you are missing — the Cameroon-to-Germany example on this page starts with no IELTS — and the plan includes the test or document as a step instead of blocking on it.

NG.line: Nigeria PAYE runs the PITA 2025 and NTA 2026 band regimes side by side, with pension and NHF options — and VAT prefills at 7.5% under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025.

KE.line: Kenya payroll carries KRA's five bands, SHIF at 2.75% (minimum KES 300), the 1.5% housing levy, and NSSF on the KES 108,000 ceiling that took effect in February 2026.

GH.line: Ghana runs GRA's seven bands (0–35%) with SSNIT Tier I+II at 5.5% and an optional Tier III deduction, on 2025 rates.

ZA.line: South Africa applies SARS 2025/26 bands (18–45%) with rebates and medical tax credits, plus UIF and SDL at 1% each.

faqs.question: Can it find my HS code?
